sets.title: Sort and Transform
sets.description: Sort particles by function and transform sentences using different particles

categorySorting.instruction: Sort these sentences by particle function

items.prompt: Where does ли go in an indirect question?
items.promptEnglish: What is the position of ли?
options: At the beginning of the clause
At the end of the sentence
items.hint: Ли follows the word that is in question.
items.explanation: Ли goes right after the word in question: придёт ЛИ он, дома ЛИ она.

items.prompt: _____ мы уже не виделись? Где ты была? (emphasizing how long it's been)
items.promptEnglish: We haven't seen each other for so long! Where have you been?
items.hint: Же after a question word adds emotional emphasis.
items.explanation: Сколько же = 'how long it's been!' (emphatic). Же intensifies the question.

items.prompt: _____ ты помнишь, как всё начиналось? (after all, you remember...)
items.promptEnglish: After all, you remember how it all started?
items.hint: Appealing to something the listener should remember.
items.explanation: Ведь appeals to shared memory: 'After all, you remember...'

items.prompt: Я _____ помог, но у меня не было времени.
items.promptEnglish: I would have helped, but I didn't have time.
items.explanation: Бы + past = conditional: 'I would have helped.'

items.prompt: _____ ты знаешь, что это неправда! (After all, you know...)
items.promptEnglish: After all, you know this isn't true!
items.explanation: Ведь appeals to something both speakers know: 'After all, you know...'

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ знал об этом! (He DID know - emphatic)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He knew about this! (emphatic: I'm reminding you he knew)
minimalPairs.explanation: Же emphasizes a known fact: 'He DID know!' Reminding the listener.

errorCorrection.sentence: Ведь ты это сделал?! Не может быть! (meant: amazed surprise)
errorCorrection.hint: Amazed surprise = неужели, not ведь (which appeals to known facts).
errorCorrection.explanation: Неужели = 'Can it really be?!' (amazement). Ведь = 'after all' (shared knowledge).

errorCorrection.sentence: Я бы говорил тебе вчера! (meant: I DID tell you yesterday!)
errorCorrection.hint: Emphatic reminder = же. Бы would mean 'I would have told.'
errorCorrection.explanation: Я же говорил тебе! = 'I DID tell you!' Же for emphasis. Бы would mean hypothetical.

translation.english: I don't know whether they will agree.
acceptableVariants: Я не знаю, согласятся ли они.
translation.hint: Indirect question with ли after the verb

translation.english: I would go, but I'm busy.
translation.answer: Я бы пошёл, но я занят.
acceptableVariants: Я бы пошла, но я занята.
Я бы пошёл, но я сейчас занят.

sets.title: Context Reading
sets.description: Choose the right particle based on the speaker's intent

items.prompt: Speaker is wondering to themselves: "Интересно, получится _____ у меня..."
items.hint: Internal wondering = indirect question with ли.
items.explanation: Ли in an indirect question: 'whether I'll succeed.'

items.prompt: Speaker is shocked at good news: "_____ ты серьёзно?! Поздравляю!"
items.hint: Amazed at something wonderful and surprising.
items.explanation: Неужели = amazed wonder: 'Can this really be true?!' Positive surprise.

items.prompt: Speaker knows the listener understands: "_____ ты сам всё понимаешь."
items.promptEnglish: After all, you understand everything yourself.
items.hint: Appealing to what the listener already knows = ведь.
items.explanation: Ведь = 'after all, you already understand.' Appealing to shared understanding.

items.prompt: Speaker would change careers if possible: "Я _____ стал музыкантом, если бы мог."
items.promptEnglish: I would become a musician if I could.
items.explanation: Бы + past = conditional: 'I would become...' Hypothetical, not real.

patternRecognition.sentence: Ты же обещал! / Мы же договорились! / Я же сказал!
patternRecognition.question: What function does же serve in all three?
options: Emphatic reminder of a known fact
patternRecognition.answer: Emphatic reminder of a known fact
patternRecognition.explanation: Же after the subject emphasizes: 'You DID promise / We DID agree / I DID say.' Reminding the listener.

patternRecognition.sentence: Не знаю, придёт ли он. / Интересно, успеем ли мы. / Сомневаюсь, сможет ли она.
patternRecognition.question: What structure unifies these sentences?
patternRecognition.explanation: All use verb + ли to create indirect questions: 'whether he'll come / we'll make it / she can.'

patternRecognition.sentence: Ведь это правда. / Ведь ты знаешь. / Ведь мы друзья.
patternRecognition.question: What does ведь do in all three?
patternRecognition.explanation: Ведь in all three says: 'after all, you know this.' Appealing to what both speakers know.

blanks: Я _____ тебе помог, если бы ты попросил. (I would have helped...)
_____ она ещё не ушла? Встреча давно кончилась. (She hasn't left yet?!)
Мы _____ говорили об этом! Ты забыл? (We DID talk about this!)
hints: Surprised that the expected thing didn't happen.
explanations: Бы + past = conditional: 'I would have helped.'
Разве = disbelief that she's still there when the meeting ended long ago.
Же = emphatic: 'We DID talk about this!' Reminding the listener.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All six particles in varied exercise formats
sets.descriptionRussian: Все шесть частиц в разных форматах

items.prompt: Мне _____ с ней поговорить. (I should talk to her - soft suggestion)
items.promptEnglish: I should probably talk to her.
items.explanation: Мне бы поговорить = 'I should talk to her.' Бы softens the statement into a suggestion.

items.prompt: _____ ты сдал экзамен?! Молодец! (Did you really pass?! amazed)
items.promptEnglish: You really passed the exam?! Well done!
items.explanation: Неужели = amazed wonder at positive news: 'Can it really be that you passed?!'

items.prompt: Он _____ рассказал нам всю правду. (He DID tell us the whole truth.)
items.promptEnglish: He DID tell us the whole truth. (emphatic)
items.explanation: Же emphasizes: 'He DID tell us.' Stating a known fact emphatically.

items.promptEnglish: Tell me, do you like it here? (whether you like it)
items.explanation: Ли creates a softened question: 'Tell me whether you like it here.'

items.prompt: _____ мы все взрослые люди. Давайте решим это спокойно.
items.promptEnglish: After all, we're all adults. Let's resolve this calmly.
items.hint: Appealing to a fact everyone knows = ведь.
items.explanation: Ведь = 'after all, we all know we're adults.' Appealing to shared understanding.

errorCorrection.hint: Ли goes after the verb, not before the subject.
errorCorrection.explanation: Correct: придёт ли он. Ли follows the word in question.

errorCorrection.sentence: Неужели вы не знаете? Все уже знают! (meant: disbelief they don't know)
errorCorrection.hint: Disbelief that someone doesn't know = разве, not неужели.
errorCorrection.explanation: Разве вы не знаете? = 'Don't you know?!' Disbelief at a negative. Неужели = amazement at a positive.

errorCorrection.sentence: Бы ты мне сказал! (meant: You DID tell me!)
errorCorrection.explanation: Же ты мне сказал! Wait - actually: Ты же мне сказал! Же for emphatic reminder.
